sehemu: Part I: Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and President of Zanzibar
jina: Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and his authority
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar who shall be the President of Zanzibar and Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and also Chairman of the Revolutionary Council of Zanzibar. (2) Before assuming office, the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar shall take before the Chief Justice of Zanzibar the oath to protect and defend the Constitution of the United Republic, and any other oath prescribed by the Constitution of Zanzibar in relation to the discharge of his functions, and shall thereafter hold and exercise those powers in accordance with this Constitution and the Constitution of Zanzibar, 1984. (3) In addition to his other powers, the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar shall appoint and assign responsibilities to Ministers and Deputy Ministers of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar.
vifungu: (1) There shall be a Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar who shall be the President of Zanzibar and Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and also Chairman of the Revolutionary Council of Zanzibar.

(2) Before assuming office, the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar shall take before the Chief Justice of Zanzibar the oath to protect and defend the Constitution of the United Republic, and any other oath prescribed by the Constitution of Zanzibar in relation to the discharge of his functions, and shall thereafter hold and exercise those powers in accordance with this Constitution and the Constitution of Zanzibar, 1984.

(3) In addition to his other powers, the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar shall appoint and assign responsibilities to Ministers and Deputy Ministers of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar.
